name: voyager-ai-backend
description: Voyager AI Backend - Python API for travel itinerary generation

scripts.install:venv: python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.lint: python -m flake8 app/ || echo 'Flake8 not configured'
scripts.format: python -m black app/ || echo 'Black not configured'
scripts.test: python -m pytest tests/ || echo 'Tests not configured'
scripts.migrate: python -m flask db upgrade || echo 'No migrations configured'
scripts.seed: python app/seed.py || echo 'No seed script found'

author: Voyager AI Team
